"Short-Distance New Heroine: King Halo" 
"Spring and Autumn Domination Next Year as 
Well!?" ...As she basked in the breaking 
news articles in the waiting room, her 
phone rang――

It was a phone call from King Halo's 
mother. When asked if she would continue 
on the sprint and mile route, King Halo's 
answer was the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

Exasperated as her daughter took on yet 
another new stage, her mother simply said, 
"Just try and win, if you can."

Unlike the usual "come back home," these 
words sent her off as an Umamusume who 
runs in races. King Halo laughed, noting 
how late it was for that.
